get.description: Returns outlets with live load, totals, system state, thresholds and recent events.
Returns the POL-01..POL-08 event-condition-action policy repository.

post.description: Runs the POL-02/POL-03 pre-activation assessment for an outlet and records the decision.
Opens the outlet relay and zeroes its live load (manual toggle-off path).
Disconnects the lowest-priority energized outlets first (POL-05).

put.description: Updates priority, allowance, schedule or idle limit for an outlet. The ID in the URL must match the ID in the payload.
Updates capacity, warning/critical limits and standby/idle tuning values.

post.description: Stores per-outlet PZEM readings, refreshes live outlet state, and evaluates threshold crossings and fault lockout.

get.description: Returns thresholds and the outlet policy table so the ESP32 can synchronize before evaluating POL-01..POL-08 locally.

post.description: Creates a new todo item using the provided details and returns the ID of the created item.

put.description: Updates the specified todo item. The ID in the URL must match the ID in the payload.

delete.description: Deletes the todo item with the specified ID.

patch.description: Updates the detail fields of a specific todo item. The ID in the URL must match the ID in the payload.

get.description: Retrieves all todo lists along with their items.

post.description: Creates a new todo list using the provided details and returns the ID of the created list.

put.description: Updates the specified todo list. The ID in the URL must match the ID in the payload.

delete.description: Deletes the todo list with the specified ID.

post.description: Authenticates a user. Use ?useCookies=true for cookie-based authentication.
Returns a new access token using a valid refresh token.

get.description: Confirms a user's email address using the token sent by email.

post.description: Sends a new email confirmation link to the specified address.
Sends a password reset link to the specified email address.
Resets a user's password using the token sent by email.
Enables, disables, or retrieves two-factor authentication settings.

get.description: Returns the current user's email and two-factor authentication status.

post.description: Updates the current user's email or password.
Logs out the current user by clearing the authentication cookie.

get.description: Retrieves a list of weather forecasts for the next few days.
